daily_briefing:
The most important story today is the introduction of GPT-5.6 by OpenAI, which significantly reduces costs for AI deployment while advancing the price-performance frontier in AI technology. This development allows enterprises to integrate more efficient AI workflows on platforms like Luna and Terra, making cutting-edge AI capabilities accessible to a broader range of businesses.

The second-biggest trend is the advancement in robotics through Gemini Robotics' new models, ER 2 and Gemini Robotics 2. These innovations enhance robot capabilities with whole-body intelligence, advanced video understanding, task orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration. This progress could revolutionize various industries by improving efficiency and effectiveness of robotic systems.

Readers should watch for how companies manage idle GPUs more efficiently, treating them as a valuable resource akin to grounded aircraft. This trend highlights the growing importance of optimizing hardware resources in today's tech landscape, ensuring that even underutilized assets contribute effectively to operational performance.
